definitions: Collaborative business arrangements between two or more parties that primarily leverage intellectual property, brand, or services rather than significant physical assets or capital.
Partnerships designed to achieve strategic goals with minimal investment in tangible assets, often focusing on shared expertise, market access, or technology.
examples: They formed asset-light joint ventures to expand into new markets.
The company preferred asset-light joint ventures for their flexibility.
Many tech firms utilize asset-light joint ventures to innovate.
